page_title: CRY 2-3 BUR | Crystal Palace v Burnley 11/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+6' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the left side of the goal, but Martin Dubravka is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
90+4' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.

90+3' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Crystal Palace) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Ismaila Sarr, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
90+2' Crystal Palace win a corner.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Crystal Palace failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) takes a rebound on the edge of the box and slams the ball well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
89' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
89' Christantus Uche (Crystal Palace) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
87' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Lesley Ugochukwu as he is replaced by Florentino (Burnley).
85' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Martin Dubravka comes off the line to clear the ball away.
84' Josh Laurent (Burnley) pounces on a bouncing ball on the edge of the box, but sends his volley high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
84' James Ward-Prowse (Burnley) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
83' Scott Parker decides to make a substitution. Hannibal Mejbri will be replaced by James Ward-Prowse (Burnley).
83' Substitution. Adam Wharton makes way for Christantus Uche (Crystal Palace).
81' Chadi Riad (Crystal Palace) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.

77' Brennan Johnson (Crystal Palace) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
76' Crystal Palace can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
74' Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Farai Hallam's book.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Zian Flemming departs the field of play to be replaced by Lyle Foster (Burnley).
73' The referee allows time for a substitution. Marcus Edwards will be replaced by Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley).
72' Substitution. Daniel Munoz is replaced by Will Hughes (Crystal Palace).
72' Oliver Glasner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) replacing Daichi Kamada.
71' Josh Laurent (Burnley) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
71' Brennan Johnson (Crystal Palace) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

70' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace have been awarded a corner kick.
69' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) crashes a header just wide of the left post from close range after a searching cross. He should have scored!
67' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
65' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Crystal Palace) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
65' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) produces a long-range strike, but he only hits one of his own teammates standing in its way.
64' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

63' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.

62' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) watches the ball all the way and connects well with a volley on the edge of the box, but sends the effort miles past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
62' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Jorgen Strand Larsen (Crystal Palace), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
59' Josh Laurent (Burnley) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
58' Substitution. Brennan Johnson (Crystal Palace) in, Evann Guessand out.
56' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender.
54' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
51' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header well wide of the left post. What a poor effort.
51' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

50' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear. Crystal Palace have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

49' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a powerful shot from mid-range which was stopped by one of the defenders.
48' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
47' Close! Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
46' We are about to witness a substitution. Chadi Riad (Crystal Palace) is replacing Jefferson Lerma.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' Farai Hallam has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+2' 2 - 3 This is really unlucky! Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) attempted to clear the ball away after the opposition’s corner kick into the box, but instead miskicked the clearance and put it into his own net, specifically low into the middle of the net. He won't enjoy watching the highlights later.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle, Burnley are awarded a corner kick.

45+2' Marcus Edwards (Burnley) attempts to whip a quick pass into the box, but Zian Flemming was not able to dribble past the opponent's defence and loses the ball. The ball goes out for a corner. Burnley can continue in their attacking effort.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' 2 - 2 Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom left corner.
43' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Crystal Palace) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
42' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
40' 2 - 1 Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to unleash a great effort which ends up in the right side of the goal.
37' A cross by Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
36' Farai Hallam shows a yellow card to Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) for his blatant foul.
35' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
33' 2 - 0 Goal! Jorgen Strand Larsen (Crystal Palace) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Jefferson Lerma and easily beat the keeper with a header into the bottom left corner from close range. 2:0.
30' Farai Hallam interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jorgen Strand Larsen (Crystal Palace).
29' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
28' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) takes it short.
27' Farai Hallam blows his whistle and it's Lesley Ugochukwu (Burnley) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
26' Josh Laurent (Burnley) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
26' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Farai Hallam has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
24' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) commits a foul and Farai Hallam immediately signals a free kick.
23' CHANCE! Zian Flemming (Burnley) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top.
23' Dean Henderson is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Josh Laurent (Burnley). Easy save!
20' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
19' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
17' 1 - 0 Adam Wharton finds Jorgen Strand Larsen (Crystal Palace) with a sweet pass inside the penalty box, who then smashes the ball inside the right post. What a clinical finish to make it 1:0.
14' Farai Hallam blows his whistle for a foul after Jorgen Strand Larsen (Crystal Palace) hacks down one of his opponents.
13' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) tries to find Jorgen Strand Larsen, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
12' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
11' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the left post.
9' Joe Worrall (Burnley) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.

7' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
6' Farai Hallam blows his whistle as Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
4' Burnley are ruled offside.
4' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Ismaila Sarr.
1' The match has just started.
Crystal Palace will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Farai Hallam.
